candidate.definition_en: To take and keep a firm hold of; grasp tightly.
candidate.explanation_ar: يمسك حاجة جامد، أو يسيطر على انتباه حد.

senses.definition_en: To take and keep a firm hold of something; grasp tightly.
examples: Make sure you grip the steering wheel firmly when driving on icy roads.

senses.definition_en: To affect deeply or hold someone's attention completely.
senses.explanation_ar: يسيطر على مشاعر شخص أو يستحوذ على كامل انتباهه.
examples: A sudden feeling of panic began to grip the passengers as the turbulence worsened.
The dramatic thriller will grip audiences from the opening scene to the final twist.
